notes.title: THE FALL OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN - Episode One: The Call
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="IWPlJMr5FYM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]After a year of (admittedly intermittent) work, The Fall of the Public Domain has finally begun. Oswald the Lucky Rabbit begins an adventure full of mystery, danger, and an existential threat unlike anything the world fiction has ever known before![/p][p]Thank you so much for not getting mad at me for the period of time when this looked like an abandoned cash-grab. Sitting and letting people think Inverse Ninjas was just another Heartbound or gag game meant to capitalize. But... to some degree it was. At least for the brief moments after the failed Kickstarter when I thought "hey this thing didn't make enough money guess I'll just leave the people who bought it originally out to dry."[/p][p]Well I'm not gonna keep patting myself on the back. It's still an incredibly humble thing, The Fall. I hope you guys enjoy it anyway.[/p][p]The game's going to remain 5 bucks until all 7 episodes are out.[/p][p]Thanks for everything guys. I hope this is some small consolation.[/p]

notes.title: The Fall of the Public Domain
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759237/73bcfed89bc5bd1ffe0fb8d0459ab5ab94c4ea92.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759237/e6445875ee726fb7fbe36a5c66d468e95b82103e.png[/img]

For those not in the know:

The Kickstarter was a failure. But I decided to try to make the game anyway on a $0 budget.

It will be a humble single-player campaign with Oswald the Lucky Rabbit as the sole playable character.

I've been working on it for some time, trying to scrape together time and money to put toward it. I also occasionally post about it on Twitter at @InverseNinjas

And the first episode will be a free update to the game (which will remain $5) that comes out either June or July.

See ya there, folks.

notes.title: DAN BACKSLIDE sneaks his unsavory self into INVERSE NINJAS
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759237/c2671d4d4f11b08d68b72c6886b334ea13c33b9f.png[/img]

The next character has made his sly and undignified appearance in Inverse Ninjas VS. The Public Domain!

This is going to be a fairly small update compared to what we've got coming up, but might as well have some fun with it!

Character modding has been added to the game, there will be a pinned post in the community tab on how to get started there, and if you'd like to get your hands on the Evil Sherlock mod, then click here until Nexus Mods stops being Nexus Mods and publishes the mod properly! https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/v6ybvc8x7iiah8p754m11/EvilSherlockMod.zip?rlkey=rqthnmsv0er2aibfrfjzbsfeh&dl=0

Otherwise - These are the major additions:

New character: Dan Backslide
New weapon: Wrench
New stage: Mt. Tarius (artistically incompatible with the rest of the game, but hey, let's have some fun)
New pause menu music
Character modding
New suite of character palette swaps

notes.title: Patch Notes 1/14/2024
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1/14/2024

-Final ""boss"" is killable in Cooperative and Single Player Survival
-Added spike traps to The Arena
-Sound effect added for windblast
-Switching from controller to keyboard as P1 should be SUPER easy now
-Character names and animation speeds stored externally for modding purposes (check %LOCALAPPDATA%/PublicDomainVSInverseNinjas to try it out)
-Mickey's harpoon bug fixed
-"Liddel" removed from Alice's name. I forgot that Carroll was kind of a creep and Liddel was the name of the real little girl he was trying to marry so I dunno yeah I just don't feel like touching that one with a 49.5 foot pole.
-Winnie the Pooh changed to Winnie-the-Pooh less because I think I'm in hot water legally with it, but more because I feel like being more faithful to the source material and also a cool fan suggested it.

notes.title: Inverse Ninjas VS. The Public Domain ROADMAP
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759237/14aa0d24056e50b46eb9f011e07b5464558d171c.png[/img]

FAQ:

Wait, Dan Backslide is public domain?

Yeah! Can you believe it? In very much the same fashion as Night of the Living Dead, The Dover Boys failed to have their copyright renewed. I personally think WB should do Dover Boys stuff anyway but hey whatever.

'Survivors Mode'?

Yeah. You know. Like that other game I got addicted to for like a whole month.
It's going to be different than the game as a whole, with the very likely excision of pathfinding for technical reasons but I think it's gonna be fun.

'Story Mode'?

It's a LITTLE bit wishful thinking but yes, I have an idea for a story mode, it's called Rule of Inverse Ninjas and it'd be a goddamned blast but that would probably be the most expensive thing I could attempt with this game. It and online multiplayer are *really* rickety but damn it, I wanna do ONE of 'em.

Can the character after Dan Backslide be [this public domain character]?

We're open to suggestions! Let us know 'em here! This ain't a democracy, I'll decide which gets chosen next but man I love the engagement.

Anything else?

We're considering looking for ways to store the character info externally for easier modding so anyone can put any character in, but we'll see.

notes.title: THE MOUSE IS IN THE HOUSE
notes.notes:
In our efforts to be the very first, Inverse Ninjas VS. The Public Domain has signed an extremely expensive licensing deal of $0.00 to acquire the exceptionally non-exclusive rights to the most widely beloved cartoon character of all time that isn't named Bugs Bunny: MICKEY MOUSE from the hit cartoon Steamboat Willie!

He's available right now as a free update with the game, playable and introducing a new gun to the roster: a harpoon that might be SLIGHTLY overpowered!

Patch notes are as follows:
-Mickey Mouse is in the game now
-Harpoon available as a starter weapon for Mickey Mouse as well as now included in the rotating roster of pick-up guns
-Mouse and Keyboard support for single player
-Minor bug fixes

Known Issues:
-Ending ninja still un-killable in cooperative and single player mode
-Still requires a controller for the first player AND second player despite KB+M controls
